artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: six phases complete, phase 7 blocked, full blocker record and recommended resolution.
Plan updated with per-phase status, scope-hypothesis results, inline deviation annotations, and the Phase 7 BLOCKER record.

blockers: Phase 7 Invariant A is not provable as written. Padding by repetition preserves the decoded label function only at multiples of the cycle length, so the invariant needs L divides plusCompressionBound for every extracted cycle length L, which exists_good_cycle_of_plusTypeSeq does not supply; at a three-member closure the permitted lengths are 1 through 8 while the bound is 56, and back lengths 5, 7 and 8 have no common multiple below 280. Independently, the risk-table outcome it serves (NB = NF = plusCompressionBound) is false: PlusWitnessFamily/Decide.lean's perBack is repBack.length times the PRODUCT of the lassos' back lengths, never a least common multiple. Recommended resolution: drop Invariant A, which nothing downstream needs for correctness.
next_action_hint: Decide Invariant A before any further dispatch. Do not start Phase 8; phases 8-13 all depend on Phase 7. The full blocker record, the three resolution options, and a working replacement mechanism for Invariant B are under the Phase 7 heading of the plan.
